name: re-discipline
description: Evidence-based reverse-engineering knowledge: local retrieval, shared community libraries, offline search, and reviewed publication.

interface.shortDescription: Curated RE knowledge: search it, campaign it, promote findings.
interface.longDescription: Curate reverse-engineering findings in .re-discipline/docs/, search local and connected community libraries, and carry accepted knowledge offline. Create communities, invite collaborators, publish selected portable findings, and review contributions through your agent or the optional dashboard.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search the project knowledge base with the re-search query tool before investigating anything. Follow .re-discipline/CONVENTIONS.md for reports, findings, and promotion.
